{"id":2075730078,"question_id":3805,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"2 days, 4 hours","timestamp":1784632435,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/2075730078/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Maximize Active Section with Trade I","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int maxActiveSectionsAfterTrade(string s) {\n        int n = s.size();\n        vector<int>leftzeros(n), rightzeros(n);\n        int ones = s[0] == '1' ? 1 : 0;\n\n        leftzeros[0] = (s[0] == '0') ? 1 : 0;\n        rightzeros[n-1] = (s[n-1] == '0') ? 1 : 0;\n\n        for(int i = 1 ; i < n ; i++) \n        {\n            if(s[i] == '1') ones++;\n            leftzeros[i] = (s[i] == '0') ? leftzeros[i-1] + 1 : 0;\n        }\n\n        for(int i = n-2 ; i >= 0 ; i--) rightzeros[i] = (s[i] == '0') ? rightzeros[i+1] + 1 : 0;\n\n        int ans = 0;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i < n ; i++)\n        {   \n            if(s[i] == '1')\n            {\n                if(i-1 >= 0 and i+1 < n) ans = max(ans , leftzeros[i-1] + rightzeros[i+1]);\n            }\n        }\n\n        return ans + ones;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"maximize-active-section-with-trade-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2351}
